goal.objective: Activate and continuously advance the stable non-authorizing StegGate rendezvous through the single StegVerse heartbeat until live acceptance passes or an explicit authority/provider boundary remains blocked.
success_predicates: The worker is atomically claimed and heartbeat-timed in the canonical worker registry.
Missing credential values remain BLOCKED with an inspectable heartbeat checkpoint.
When credential values become available, the worker validates Cloudflare Workers capability before deployment.
Only the canonical Site rendezvous source blob is deployed.
The stable route passes readiness, canonical health, and exact ALLOW/DENY/REVIEW/FAIL_CLOSED self-test.
No credential value is persisted in repository state or receipts.
failure_predicates: Credential absence is treated as completion.
Heartbeat availability is treated as deployment authority.
Mutable/unverified Site worker source is deployed.
Deployment success is treated as live acceptance without probes.
Credential values are written to repository state or logs by this worker.

task.derivation_reason: User requires unresolved session work to be activated under the single heartbeat and worker task registry rather than merely durably documented.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while task remains unfinished

completion.next_authorized_action: On each admitted heartbeat, re-evaluate the Cloudflare credential boundary; when values are present, validate capability, deploy the canonical rendezvous, and prove stable live acceptance.
terminal_when: Worker returns COMPLETED with transition LIVE_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
Stable readiness and health are externally observable
Self-test proves ALLOW, DENY, REVIEW, and FAIL_CLOSED
Completion evidence contains no credential values

block.machine_observable_release_condition: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are both present in the authorized heartbeat execution environment.
block.worker_behavior: Remain claimed/heartbeat-visible and emit BLOCKED checkpoints until the release condition becomes true.
